data.desc: Avino is a silver producer operating in Durango, Mexico, with the goal of long-term sustainable and profitable mining operations to reward shareholders and the community alike through our growth at the historic Avino Property and the strategic acquisition of the adjacent La Preciosa Property. La Preciosa is one of the largest permitted silver assets in Mexico and is only 19 kilometres from the Avino mill. It is currently in the development stage, with 3,000 metres of underground development been completed to date. Avino's inaugural proven and probable mineral reserves announced April 2026 totaled 127 million silver equivalent ounces, and the updated measured and indicated mineral resource base is 301 million silver equivalent ounces. Avino is included in the Toronto Stock Exchange's TSX30 for the second consecutive year, having distinguished itself by being ranked in the 5th position in both 2025 and 2026.
